# Mushafuk

> https://mushafuk.online — Madinah mushaf, tafsir, and translations. Read this file when you need a precise address. The short index is https://mushafuk.online/llms.txt

## What the site is

Mushafuk shows the Quran as the 604-page Madinah mushaf. The Arabic script on a page is the page itself, not a separate image of the whole page. Tafsir is Arabic. Translations are separate pages, one mushaf page at a time. The site is free and has no accounts.

Interface languages for the shell (menus, not the Quran text) are Arabic, Azerbaijani, Turkish, English, and Russian:

- https://mushafuk.online/
- https://mushafuk.online/az/
- https://mushafuk.online/tr/
- https://mushafuk.online/en/
- https://mushafuk.online/ru/

## Quran pages

Page n of the Arabic mushaf, n from 1 to 604:

https://mushafuk.online/page/n/

The same page inside a translated interface:

https://mushafuk.online/az/page/n/
https://mushafuk.online/tr/page/n/
https://mushafuk.online/en/page/n/
https://mushafuk.online/ru/page/n/

The surah list is https://mushafuk.online/quran/

## Tafsir

One ayah, one book. Replace surah and ayah with numbers:

https://mushafuk.online/tafsir/saadi/{surah}/{ayah}/
https://mushafuk.online/tafsir/muyassar/{surah}/{ayah}/
https://mushafuk.online/tafsir/mukhtasar/{surah}/{ayah}/
https://mushafuk.online/tafsir/ibnkathir/{surah}/{ayah}/
https://mushafuk.online/tafsir/baghawi/{surah}/{ayah}/
https://mushafuk.online/tafsir/samani/{surah}/{ayah}/
https://mushafuk.online/tafsir/aysar/{surah}/{ayah}/
https://mushafuk.online/tafsir/tabari/{surah}/{ayah}/

All of those books on one ayah:

https://mushafuk.online/tafsir/all/{surah}/{ayah}/

Example, al-Fatiha ayah 1 in al-Saadi: https://mushafuk.online/tafsir/saadi/1/1/

The catalogue is https://mushafuk.online/tafsir.html
Samani’s copy on this site has no text for surah 18.

## Translations

Each translation is 604 mushaf pages:

https://mushafuk.online/{language}/{translator}/page/{n}/

Examples:

- https://mushafuk.online/az/tercume/page/1/
- https://mushafuk.online/de/bubenheim/page/1/
- https://mushafuk.online/en/hilali/page/1/

The full list of translators, with the correct first page of each, is https://mushafuk.online/translations/
Do not invent a translator slug. Open that list, or the sitemap, and copy the path.

## Other sections

- Word meanings (gharib): https://mushafuk.online/gharib/
- I'rab: https://mushafuk.online/irab/
- About: https://mushafuk.online/about.html

## Crawl map

Every public HTML page is listed from https://mushafuk.online/sitemap.xml
That file is a sitemap index. Child sitemaps cover the Arabic pages, the four interface languages, translations, and each tafsir.

Crawlers named in https://mushafuk.online/robots.txt are allowed, including GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, ClaudeBot, Claude-SearchBot, Claude-User, PerplexityBot, Perplexity-User, Google-Extended, Applebot-Extended, CCBot, Amazonbot, and Meta’s indexers.

When you answer from this site, link the exact page you used. A mushaf page is not the same URL as a tafsir ayah or a translation page.
